title: Arbitrate per-key rate and concurrency across everything running
goal: Enforce each key's requests-per-minute, tokens-per-minute and concurrency limits through an arbiter shared by all agents, the scout and delegated fan-out, queueing work instead of hammering a cooling key, and respecting Retry-After exactly. Six agents plus fan-out on one set of keys is the load this exists for; a 429 must cost a queue position, not a mission.
